variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create an original polished game art-direction presentation image for ZANKII, an indie side-scrolling geometric Wave game. This is a visual style proposal for a user to vote on, not a screenshot of an existing game. Landscape image, approximately 16:10. Beautiful precise production-ready 2D game interface, no device frame, no photographs, no perspective. Composition: upper 70% is a full-width large gameplay screen, lower 30% is a clean graphic design board showing a compact level-selection menu preview at left, five color swatches in the center, and the proposal number and short style name at right. In the gameplay screen show a SINGLE small sharp arrow player pointing diagonally upwards near one-third across the screen with a thin continuous angular zigzag trail behind it; straight diagonal segments and abrupt 45-degree bends, never sine curves. The player moves through a wide readable corridor between geometric platforms and triangular obstacles attached to top and bottom; a welcoming beginner level, about 5 distinct obstacle groups, absolutely no impossible walls across the corridor. Clear foreground/background hierarchy: hazards clearly distinct from subtle distant decorations. Compact top HUD: ZANKII at left, a thin progress bar centered, '32%' beside it, tiny pause button right. Small level title 'FIRST FLIGHT'. Bottom menu preview has three simple clean rounded level buttons numbered 01, 02, 03, with titles 'FIRST FLIGHT', 'SOFT RHYTHM', 'AFTERGLOW'. Comfortable spacing and crisp understated modern sans-serif typography. Calm and playful, recognizable geometric arcade language but original layout and assets, no copied Geometry Dash logo/icons. No flashing or aggressive bloom, no skulls, no huge dashboard, no fake browser chrome. Art direction 01 / MINT FLOW. An airy, tactile minimal geometric arcade world. Off-white pale mint background with extremely faint square grid and layered softly curved abstract hills far behind the corridor. Deep muted petrol platform fills, thin mint green bright edges, crisp warm ivory triangular spikes, a bright mint green arrow and matching zigzag trail with gentle narrow glow. Rounded rectangular panels, tiny soft shadows, clean contemporary friendly visual language. Use generous breathing room and restrained decoration. Palette: #EAF6F0 #163F3C #69C9AC #F7FAF3 #A9CABE. Label bottom right exactly '01' and 'MINT FLOW'. The board should feel fresh, calm, high-end, readable and light, not a neon night scene.
